title: Toxic
description: Toxic, in toxic look cinematography, is air as contamination: sick greens, yellow haze, fumes you can backlight. The air is a hazard, and a teal grade with no particles is not poison.

sections.title: How it works

blocks.text: Eye height or slightly low, 35mm, lock-off. Backlight the fumes so the poison is visible.
Acid greens and urine yellows, wet ground, a figure. Prompt: Toxic air around [Subject], sick greens, yellow haze, poison you can see.

sections.title: Questions

blocks.text: What is Toxic in film?
Chemical weather: sick greens, yellow haze, fumes you can see. The air is the hazard. A green LUT is not enough.
Toxic vs Fog
Fog is water droplets, usually neutral. Toxic is contamination with a sick palette and visible fumes. If the air is white and harmless, you wanted fog.
When should I use Toxic?
Industry, hell, a poisoned city. Skip picnics and clean-air grades.
How do I prompt Toxic for AI image or video?
Backlight fumes, then: Toxic air around [Subject], sick greens, yellow haze, poison you can see. Forbid biohazard letters. Keep a readable figure.
